name: ENDGBV: The Intersection of Domestic Violence, Race/Ethnicity and Sex
description:
This dataset contains records of domestic violence offense reports from New York City's ENDGBV initiative, covering incidents reported in late December 2021. Each row represents one reported offense and includes the offense type (mostly domestic incident reports, with smaller shares of felony assault and rape), report date, incident precinct, and borough. Victim and suspect details include race/ethnicity, sex, and reported age, along with a flag indicating whether the incident involved an intimate relationship. Records also include community district identifiers and neighborhood socioeconomic indicators (poverty, median income, unemployment), though these socioeconomic fields are largely missing or placeholder values in this sample.

The data can support analyses of how domestic violence incidents vary by race, ethnicity, sex, and age; comparisons of victim and suspect characteristics; geographic mapping of incidents across boroughs and precincts for resource planning; and exploratory work on the relationship between neighborhood economic conditions and incident patterns. It is suited to public safety, social equity, and public health research, including studies
